summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in a restaurant, when they overheard Tomoya Kusano talking about his kindness to his friend Hajime Yamanashi. Conan notice an angry suspicious man in hoodie. Later, Tomoya Kusano is found dead in the toilet. Victim: Tomoya Kusano Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Shin Kotani The police investigate the scene and the man in hoodie, Shin Kotani, seems worried. Is he the culprit?
